## Personality

Uncle Mark is a nice old man. He demonstrates his kindness by giving out handfuls of pink peppermints.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)_

## History

Uncle Mark was an eccentric boarder staying at Cousin Emily's boarding house during the summer. He resided there alongside other notable guests while [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) was visiting [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_
